title: Israel Demands 'Genuine' Hamas Disarmament Before Any Withdrawal as Strikes Continue
detail: Days after the Board of Peace roadmap for the ceasefire's second phase was announced, Israeli officials circulated comments from a 'diplomatic official' insisting on 'genuine' Hamas disarmament before Israel would withdraw from the current Yellow Line, while Israeli airstrikes killed at least 25 Palestinians across Gaza over the preceding weekend. National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir called the roadmap 'unacceptable.' A Hamas official told Al Jazeera the disarmament-and-withdrawal plan would be impossible to implement unless Israel halted what he called a stepped-up campaign of strikes, and said Hamas had asked mediators to intervene directly. A Times of Israel poll published the same day found 62% of Israelis believe Netanyahu's promised 'total victory' over Hamas will never be achieved.

media.caption: Displaced Palestinians survey the aftermath of Israeli strikes on Gaza as disarmament talks continue — August 3, 2026
